dublinCore.dc:title: 119 HR 10046 IH: Defense Expenditure Planning for Optimizing Throughput and Sustainment Act
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Cloud introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Armed Services

form.official-title: To authorize the Secretary of Defense to eliminate any internal Department of Defense depreciated costs or cancel any internal Department debts associated with depots and arsenal from accounts of a military department or the Department that are associated with certain capital expenditures that no longer generate revenue due to mission changes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Defense Expenditure Planning for Optimizing Throughput and Sustainment Act or the DEPOTS Act.

section.header: Capital expenditure write-offs for Department of Defense depots and arsenals

paragraph.text: With respect to any depot or arsenal of the Department of Defense, the Secretary of Defense may write-off or eliminate any internal Department accounting charges, such as remaining depreciation or internal debt from an account of a military department or the Department associated with capital assets that do not generate revenue due to mission realignments directed by the Federal Government.
Write-offs under paragraph (1) shall be done in a manner than ensures any previous cash outlay from a revolving fund is recovered.
The authority under paragraph (1) applies only to financial balances within the accounts of a military department or the Department of Defense, not to payments owed to commercial contractors.

subsection.text: The Secretary may delegate the authority under subsection (a) to the Secretary of a military department.
